challenges.says: The criterion on text that is not a number leaves the value unchanged widens the kept rule, which states only that text that is not a hexadecimal number leaves the value unchanged, so decimal text that is not a number is a behaviour no rule or decision states.

The story cites no rule (from is empty on every criterion) although it keeps two rules, and nothing in its criteria says why, so the criteria on too-large hexadecimal, unchanged value and kept name, kind and selection are not traceable to the rules they restate.

The criteria on decimal entry, hexadecimal entry and showing both forms rest on no rule or decision (only the journey idea), and the story leaves open how a typed number is marked as hexadecimal while criterion 5 already assumes it can be, so the criterion states behaviour the story itself leaves undefined.
